provenance: Official NOvA ROOT data release for arXiv:2206.10585 (xsec_{ENu,dQ2,dThdE}.root). For each variable the value TH1D/TH2D is read with uproot and the per-bin error is sqrt(diag(xsec_cov + stat_cov)) (element-wise sum of the systematic and statistical covariance TH2Ds); cross-checked against the release's xsec_*_text.txt quoted sqrt-diagonals. ENu: the covariance omits the first ROOT value bin (1.0-1.5 GeV, below threshold, also absent from the text file) so the covariance is offset by one bin (cov[i]<->value[i+1]); the released 11-bin measurement (1.5-6.0 GeV) uses total_cov[0:11,0:11]. Q2: 9 bins, covariance directly aligned. dThdE: 17 measured (cos theta_e, E) bins represented as 4 cos-theta_e slices of the electron-energy spectrum, ordered cos-outer/E-inner to match the unrolled xsec_proj1D and the 17x17 covariance ordering. Each distribution carries its own total_cov (block-diagonal in the build); values in units of 10^-39 cm^2. Target: NOvA scintillator (per nucleon).
